name: @devel-solid/agentscli
description: Generate project AGENTS.md and conventions from editable Markdown templates.

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests/unit package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/node.yml agentscli.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests/unit package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/node.yml agentscli.yml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
